catalogue.fiche.vide: Choose a unit or an algorithm.
catalogue.index_catalogue.catalogue_priv: Import prive/unites/ (outside git): the choice also applies to the simulation palette
catalogue.page.description.content: Égide unit and algorithm sheets: fidelity, equations, assumptions, validity domain, sources and code.
catalogue.page.title: Égide — catalogue
page.aide.dd_12: Close the panel or the inspector
page.aide.dd_4: Turn sound effects on or off (off at start)
page.aide.li_4: Blue pulse: a radar reports drones to the CRC; white: the CRC sends an aircraft; yellow dashes: an aircraft locks a drone with its sensor
page.aide.li_5: Control centre (CRC) and links; red cross: link cut or aircraft out of reach
page.aide.li_9: Ground bubble, paler when short of ammunition
page.autoconfig.autoconfig_arreter.title: Stop the search
page.autoconfig.note: Give the threats to consider, the available assets and the area to defend: the tool places radars, centres, targets, posts, aircraft and defensive drones, tries several layouts in simulation and keeps the one that minimises hits (MODELE § 20).
page.autoconfig.tirages_autoconfig.texte: Raids per trial and per threat
page.balayage.note: Varies a setting and replays the raid over several seeds for each value. Each point is a mean; the vertical bar, its 95 % confidence interval.
page.barre_haut.direct.title: Each group comes from a different heading, in a tight wave.
page.barre_haut.disperse.title: Each drone comes alone, from anywhere, with staggered departures.
page.barre_haut.editer.title: At the start of the raid: place targets, radars, aircraft, flight plan and zones. Paused during the raid: give orders to aircraft. (E)
page.barre_haut.essaim_reactif.title: The swarm learns from its losses: it leaves deadly targets for those already hit, bypasses defended sites and dodges air fire (MODELE § 22). (R)
page.barre_haut.fourmi.title: The whole swarm enters through a tight corridor, then bursts towards its targets.
page.barre_haut.lien_catalogue.title: Unit and algorithm sheets: equations, assumptions, sources, code
page.barre_haut.observer.title: Watch the raid in 3D on the globe, each unit at its true altitude (O)
page.barre_haut.plan_de_vol.title: The swarm follows the flight plan drawn in the editor, then heads for its targets.
page.barre_haut.tactiques.title: Swarm tactic
page.barre_haut.vue_pc.title: Switch between ground truth and what the control centre knows: known drones and tracks (V)
page.debriefing.note: Read from the log of the finished raid: what got through, why, and where the defence weakened (MODELE § 28).
page.globe.div.aria_label: 3D view of the raid on the globe
page.journal.note: What the engine has done up to now, most recent first: a radar sees, the information reaches the CRC, the CRC sends an aircraft, the aircraft receives its mission, locks a drone with its sensor, fires. Click a line to inspect the unit.

page.page.description.content: Territorial air defence against a swarm of fast drones: radars, orbiting aircraft, ground air-defence posts.

page.page.nom_deploiement.aria_label: Name of the deployment to save
page.page.p: Move the map: drag the background, or arrow keys, or Space + drag. Zoom: wheel.
page.page.p_2: Place: click a unit in the panel, then the map; right-click to finish.
page.page.p_3: Select: click; Shift+drag for a box; Ctrl+1 to 9 makes a group, 1 to 9 recalls it.
page.page.p_4: Equip: drop a means or a weapon on an already placed unit. Erase: Del, Eraser (X) or Shift+click while placing.
page.page.plan.title: Draw the swarm's flight plan (P)
page.page.ranger_deploiement.title: Store the complete scenario in this browser's library
page.page.reseau_auto.title: Link each equipped unit to the C2 centres it shares a means in range with
page.page.reseau_complet.title: Everyone talks to everyone, with no delay
page.page.retablir_edition.title: Redo the undone gesture (Ctrl+Y)
page.page.selection.title: Select and move (S)
page.page.son.title: Turn the raid's sound effects on or off (M)
